answer: Problem: one operator spins cheap fresh keys to harvest many epoch shares at once. Mechanism: a new identity sits a 96-minute lantern window and answers five 12-second probes from a rotating trio that includes one established beacon; each reply hash-chains into a mirror transcript M_i=sha256(M_{i-1}||pkt||sig). Cost: 165 POA bond plus continuous presence, blocking 8000-key farms. Verification: peers recompute the five-link transcript and drop late or reused packets. Failure: two missed probes slash 42% and delay graduation 3 epochs; a silent beacon is replaced from the standby roster in 4 min.
